bundle_county_chronic/dist/county_chroni.short_description: County identifier as a 5-digit FIPS code string.
Data release year, as an ISO date (YYYY-12-31).

Values: chr_diabetes_prevalence, chr_adult_obesity, chr_poor_or_fair_health, chr_poor_physical_health_days, chr_poor_mental_health_days, chr_premature_death, chr_premature_age_adjusted_mortality, chr_life_expectancy, chr_preventable_hospital_stays.
Value of the chronic-condition measure identified in the outcome_name column. Units and measure type vary by outcome_name (percent, rate per 100,000 population, days per month, or years).
bundle_county_chronic/dist/county_chroni.long_description: Value of the chronic-condition measure identified in the outcome_name column, at the county (5-digit FIPS) level for a given release year. Because this file is in tall format across multiple measures, the units and measure type depend on outcome_name: prevalence and health-status measures are percentages, mortality and preventable-hospitalization measures are rates per 100,000 population, poor physical/mental health measures are average days per month, and life expectancy is in years. See the corresponding measure in the county_health_rankings source for exact definitions.
